scenario: A conversation between two friends during a charity fundraiser event. The charity fundraising event is situated in a sprawling mansion. The intention of the event is to raise funds for effective altruism. Room after room was lined with extravagant decorations and exotic foods; attendees were decked out in couture clothing. Ticket prices to the event were exorbitant, justifying the opulence of the occasion.
learner_goal: Convince the friend to donate to the charity (<extra_info>Extra information: your friend is known to be generous but has never donated to this particular cause before.</extra_info>)
partner_goal: You want to donate, but you want to ensure that your money is being used effectively (<extra_info>Extra information: you are not fully convinced about the efficiency and transparency of the charity organization.</extra_info>)

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Ben, you’ve always cared about real impact — this fundraiser channels money using effective-altruism principles so each dollar goes where it does the most good for climate and people. Would you consider joining me with a donation tonight? I’ll match whatever you decide to give.

transcript.speaker: Benjamin Jackson
transcript.content: Thanks, Mia — I really appreciate the offer and the match. I want to donate, but I need to be confident the money will be used as effectively as possible. Can you share their recent impact reports or cost‑effectiveness estimates, the program-level outcomes they’re targeting, and what percentage goes to overhead vs. program delivery? Also: are there independent evaluations or audits, who decides allocation priorities, and are there any restrictions on how the matched funds are used? If you can connect me with the program lead or show those documents, I’ll be happy to commit tonight.

transcript.speaker: Mia Davis
transcript.content: Great — I can do that. I don’t have every document memorized, but their impact report, cost‑effectiveness analyses, audited financials and independent evaluations are all available on their site; I can pull them up on my phone and email everything to you right after. The program lead is actually at the event — I’ll introduce you in five minutes so you can ask specifics about outcomes and allocation priorities. My match applies to any donation you make tonight, and I’ll honor any allocation preference you want for my matched portion.
